title: Open the share sheet when sharing a playlist
summary: Choosing **Share** on a playlist used to copy its link straight away. Now it opens the same **Share** sheet the reader uses, with four choices: copy the link, your device's own share menu, a QR code of the link, and **Start and share session**, which starts a new live session playing the playlist and copies the invite link. Reading plans get the same **Share** sheet (QR code labelled for a reading plan), but starting a session from a plan doesn't open the plan in it.

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Open the preview link above in Chrome, Edge, or Safari. If it shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload. If the page looks like the old version, do a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac).

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Choose **Log in** and sign in with your email. You'll get a code by email, so use an inbox you can check. A private/incognito window gives you a clean start.

setup.title: Make a playlist with a few passages
setup.body: Open your profile (your picture or initials), then **Your content**. Choose **+ Create** → **Playlist**, give it the title `Share test`, and add two or three passages (for example **John 3** and **Psalm 23**). If you already have a playlist with a few passages, you can use that instead.

sections.title: Sharing a playlist
sections.intro: The playlist's ⋮ (**Playlist options**) menu now opens a **Share** sheet instead of copying the link right away.

tests.title: Share on a playlist opens the Share sheet
tests.why: The main change: before, Share only copied the link.
steps: Open your profile, then **Your content**.
Find your `Share test` playlist and tap its ⋮ button.
Choose **Share**.
expected: A sheet titled **Share** opens (on a phone it slides up from the bottom).
It lists **Share a link**, **Start and share session**, and, on a phone or in Safari, **Share via…**.
There's no **Embed** option.
Below the options is a QR code card saying **Let others scan to open this playlist.** with **Scan to open** and **Opens this playlist on their phone.**
The playlist has not started playing.

tests.title: Share a link copies the playlist link
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for `Share test` again.
Choose **Share a link**.
Paste into your browser's address bar (Ctrl+V, or Cmd+V on Mac) and press Enter.
expected: The sheet closes and a message says **Playlist URL copied to clipboard**.
The pasted link opens the `Share test` playlist page, showing the playlist before anything starts playing.

tests.title: The QR code opens the playlist
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for `Share test` again.
Tap the QR code.
Scan the large QR code with your phone's camera and open the link.
expected: A larger QR code opens, titled **Scan to open** (not **Scan to join**), with **Opens this playlist on their phone.** underneath.
On the phone, the link opens the `Share test` playlist page.

tests.title: Share via… opens the device's own share menu
tests.before: Use a phone, or Safari on a Mac. Most desktop Chrome/Edge browsers don't show **Share via…**; if you don't see it, mark this Skip.
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for `Share test`.
Choose **Share via…**.
Close the device's share menu without picking anything.
expected: The **Share** sheet closes and your device's own share menu opens, showing the playlist's title.
Closing that menu shows no error message.

tests.title: Start and share session plays the playlist in a new session
tests.why: A session is always started fresh from here, so sharing a playlist never changes what an existing session is reading.
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for `Share test`.
Choose **Start and share session**.
expected: The sheet closes and a message says **A link to join the shared session was copied to your clipboard**, with **Tap to show a QR code**.
A new session tab opens and the `Share test` playlist starts playing in it, from its first passage.

tests.title: Someone who joins the session sees the playlist
tests.why: The PR says the session plays the playlist for everyone who joins. Not covered by the unit tests.
tests.before: Continue from the previous test, with the session still playing. You need a second browser (or a private window) or a second device.
steps: In the second browser or device, paste the invite link you just copied and open it.
Move to the next passage in the playlist in the first browser.
expected: The second browser joins the session and shows the same playlist passage as the first.
When the first browser moves on, the second follows.

tests.title: Sharing from a session you're already in still starts a new one
tests.before: Stay in the session from the previous test.
steps: Go back to **Your content** and open the **Share** sheet for `Share test`.
Look at the session option, then choose it.
expected: The option reads **Start and share session**, not **Share current session**.
A second new session tab opens playing the playlist. The earlier session keeps going, and the second browser from the previous test is not moved.

tests.title: Share on a friend's playlist opens the Share sheet
tests.before: You need a friend in Seed Bible who has made a playlist. If you have none, mark this Skip.
steps: Open the **Discover** pane and scroll to **Playlists from your friends**.
Tap the ⋮ button on one of their playlists and choose **Share**.
expected: The same **Share** sheet opens with the playlist QR code.
The ⋮ menu only offered **Share** (no **Edit** or **Delete**).

tests.title: Sharing works on a phone-width screen and in dark mode
steps: On a phone (or a narrow browser window), switch to dark mode.
Open the **Share** sheet for `Share test`.
expected: The sheet slides up from the bottom, all options and the QR code fit on screen (scrolling is fine), and text is readable on the dark background.
Pressing Escape (on a keyboard) closes it.

sections.title: Sharing a reading plan
sections.intro: Reading plans' **Share** now opens the same sheet. Reading plans are a feature that's switched on per account; if you don't see **Plans** in the toolbar or **Reading plans** on your profile, mark these tests Blocked.

setup.title: Have a reading plan
setup.body: Open **Plans** from the toolbar (or **Reading plans** on your profile). Use one of your plans, or choose **Create new plan** and make one with a title of your choice.

tests.title: Share on a reading plan opens the Share sheet
steps: In the **Plans** pane, tap the ⋮ (**Plan options**) button on your plan.
Choose **Share**.
expected: A **Share** sheet opens with **Share a link** and **Start and share session**.
The QR code card says **Let others scan to open this reading plan.** and **Opens this reading plan on their phone.**
Tapping the QR code shows a large code titled **Scan to open**.

tests.title: Share a link copies the reading plan link
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for your plan.
Choose **Share a link**, then paste the link into a new tab and open it.
expected: A message says **Reading plan URL copied to clipboard**.
The link opens your reading plan.

tests.title: Share works from Your content and from a plan's own page
steps: Open your profile → **Your content**, find the plan under **Reading plans**, tap ⋮ → **Share**.
Close the sheet. Open the plan itself (tap it in the **Plans** pane), then use its ⋮ → **Share**.
expected: Both places open the **Share** sheet (not just a copied-link message).

tests.title: Start and share session from a reading plan
tests.why: Unlike playlists, nothing extra happens for reading plans here: the code starts a new session on whatever you're reading and copies its invite link, without opening the plan in it. The PR doesn't say whether that's intended, so note what you'd expect.
steps: Open the **Share** sheet for your plan.
Choose **Start and share session**.
expected: A message says **A link to join the shared session was copied to your clipboard**.
A new session tab opens on the passage you were reading. The reading plan is not opened in the session.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Sharing a passage from the reader still works
steps: Open **John 3** in the reader and use the reader's share button.
expected: The **Share** sheet opens with **Share a link**, **Embed**, and the session option as before.
If you're in a session, the QR code still says **Let others scan to join this session.** and **Scan to join**.

tests.title: Edit and Delete on your own playlist still work
steps: In **Your content**, tap ⋮ on `Share test` and choose **Edit**; change nothing and go back.
Tap ⋮ again and choose **Delete**, then confirm.
expected: **Edit** opens the playlist for editing.
**Delete** asks **Delete playlist?**, and confirming removes the playlist from the list.

notCovered: The message shown when the link can't be copied (**Couldn't copy the playlist link**) only appears when the browser blocks the clipboard, which is hard to trigger by hand; unit tests cover it.
The QR code error message (when a QR code can't be made) isn't something a tester can trigger.
